name: jev-skill-router
description: Route Codex skills with TypeSafe Jev and inspect local selection history in a web dashboard.

interface.shortDescription: Jev skill routing with local selection analytics.
interface.longDescription: A UserPromptSubmit hook that selects relevant skills with TypeSafe Jev, records decisions locally, and provides a bilingual web dashboard for selection rates, trends, and routing history. Explicit skill requests and existing permissions remain authoritative.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me configure Jev Skill Router.
